title: Bluegate Moving Truck Rental Class Rate Card
content:
**Bluegate Moving Truck Rental — rates by vehicle class.** Each vehicle class of the Bluegate Moving Truck Rental fleet carries its own in-town rental fee for one rental period, its own mileage rate and its own flat environmental fee. A rental period is a fixed number of elapsed hours measured from the actual pickup time.

## Rate card

| Vehicle class | Rental fee, one rental period (USD) | Rental period (elapsed hours) | Mileage, per mile driven above any included miles (USD) | Environmental fee, per contract (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bluegate Pickup Truck | 19.95 | 24 | 0.79 | 3.00 |
| Bluegate Cargo Van | 24.95 | 24 | 0.89 | 3.00 |
| Bluegate 10 ft Moving Truck | 29.95 | 24 | 0.99 | 5.00 |
| Bluegate 15 ft Moving Truck | 39.95 | 24 | 1.09 | 5.00 |
| Bluegate 20 ft Moving Truck | 39.95 | 24 | 1.19 | 5.00 |
| Bluegate 26 ft Moving Truck | 49.95 | 24 | 1.29 | 5.00 |

## Drivers and accessories

| Vehicle class | Additional authorized driver, per driver (USD) | Utility or appliance dolly, per rental (USD) | Furniture pads, one dozen, per rental (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Bluegate Pickup Truck | 0.00 | 10.00 | 10.00 |
| Bluegate Cargo Van | 0.00 | 10.00 | 10.00 |
| Bluegate 10 ft Moving Truck | 0.00 | 10.00 | 10.00 |
| Bluegate 15 ft Moving Truck | 0.00 | 10.00 | 10.00 |
| Bluegate 20 ft Moving Truck | 10.00 | 10.00 | 10.00 |
| Bluegate 26 ft Moving Truck | 10.00 | 10.00 | 10.00 |

## Reading the card

- The rental fee in the first table is the class figure for one rental period; the mileage rate applies per mile driven above any included miles; the environmental fee is a flat amount per rental contract, not per period.
- The rental period is 24 elapsed hours for every class, counted from the actual pickup time rather than from midnight.
- The Bluegate 15 ft Moving Truck and the Bluegate 20 ft Moving Truck share the same rental fee of 39.95 but differ in mileage rate (1.09 against 1.19 per mile).
- An additional authorized driver costs nothing on the four smaller classes and 10.00 per driver on the 20 ft and 26 ft trucks.
- The dolly and the dozen furniture pads are priced per rental, at 10.00 each, whatever the class.
